commit.summary: The ground moves into the crate (`native/rust/src/ground/`): FormationTerrain's cells and rules (crossing, mode, the high ground, the fastest ground), TerrainObscurance's sight, and `sim/ground/`'s surface with its relief and channels. `FormationTerrain` and `TerrainObscurance` are now views over the binding's `TerrainGround`, with the same API, so their 33 readers keep their code. The GDScript, `sim/ground/`, `tests/sim/ground/` and the pure gdUnit scenarios are gone; those scenarios are cargo tests now. No outcome changes.
commit.title: refactor(sim): the ground in the crate (spec 39 step 3a)
